germination: Use certified seed and clean nursery water.
vegetative: Keep field weed-free and avoid standing excess water.
flowering: Monitor stem borer and blast twice weekly.
harvest: Harvest when most grains are hard and straw is yellow.

germination: Sow certified seed in a well-prepared, moist seedbed.
vegetative: Irrigate at crown-root initiation and control weeds early.
flowering: Monitor rust and aphids; avoid unnecessary nitrogen.
harvest: Harvest when grains are hard and crop moisture is safe for storage.

germination: Use treated seed and maintain uniform plant spacing.
vegetative: Scout the underside of leaves and growing points for sucking pests.
flowering: Monitor bollworm traps and follow registered product labels.
harvest: Pick clean, dry kapas in multiple rounds.

germination: Plant into moist soil with uniform spacing.
vegetative: Keep the root zone weed-free and check fall armyworm.
flowering: Maintain moisture during tasseling and silking.
harvest: Harvest when husks dry and kernels are firm.

germination: Use healthy seedlings and raised, well-drained beds.
vegetative: Stake plants and avoid wetting leaves during irrigation.
flowering: Scout for whitefly, leaf curl and fruit borer.
harvest: Pick at the market-appropriate maturity and keep fruit shaded.
